name: CaseHardTextIndentEviction
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-text-indent-eviction" (text). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: text-indent: -9999px — text evicted from its own box
